name: Wow content hero (10 page variants)
purpose: Open a one-off marketing page with its H1, a short pitch and the demo CTA, in the layout measured for that page.
description: One component with a `variant` prop that switches between ten measured layouts of the `.section_wowcontent` hero: split layouts (copy left, media right, stacking to one column <=767) for small-business, enterprise, features, mentoring, case-studies and why; centred single-column layouts for solutions, spring-release and whats-included; and an empty spacer for corporate. Routes: small-business /lms/small-business, corporate /lms/corporate-lms, enterprise /lms/enterprise, solutions /lms/solutions, spring-release /lms/spring-release, features /lms/features, mentoring /mentoring, case-studies /case-studies/lms, why /company/why-nimbus, whats-included /whats-included. The H1 is serif 3.8rem/1.15 (2.5rem <=767) except case-studies (heading-h2 size).

evidenceNotes: Only /lms/enterprise and /lms/features pass props (enterprise: logoAspects only; features: a shorter title 'Platform features that improve learning and work' vs default '...learning and output'); every other page uses the component defaults.
The 'corporate' variant renders no content at all; the corporate page's H1 lives in LogosHeroOverlap, pulled up -16rem over this spacer.

Enterprise logo defaults reference third-party file names in /assets/ (src); the clone renders them as images when present, otherwise a 'Logo' text placeholder. Contract-wise these are neutral logo.customer slots.
CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md motion table lists 'ThriveGo header + cards' scroll-into-view for the small-business hero; the clone renders it static (component comment says so).
The why-variant quote uses size 'md' (18px quote, org as inline link); small-business and enterprise use 'sm' (16px, org bold).
